_comment: INTEG-GITHUB-HARDEN-1 (agent_issues 2927). The declared main ruleset for QNFO/qnfo-workers, applied only by scripts/github-settings-actions.mjs (action ruleset-main, mode live) from .github/workflows/github-settings-actions.yml. It ADDS a ruleset beside the existing main-safety (deletion, non_fast_forward); revert deletes only this name.
name: main-gate

integrations.why: workflows commit ci-status, mirrors, the charter and the portfolio straight to main with GITHUB_TOKEN
the code loop and the portfolio loop write through the qnfo-fleet GitHub App; its id is read from GET /orgs/QNFO/installations at apply time

_known_direct_pushers_why: GET /repos/QNFO/qnfo-workers/activity?ref=refs/heads/main, 2026-10-19: github-actions[bot] 47 pushes, qnfo-fleet[bot] 18 pr_merge + 5 push, rwnq8 28 pr_merge + 2 push. Live refuses when anyone else pushed directly, because the ruleset would block them.
_why_not_strict: strict_required_status_checks_policy true makes every pull request rebase whenever main moves (every few minutes here) and would stall the stale-PR lane; the checks already run on the merge ref.
_why_zero_reviews: one account authors every pull request in this fleet, so a required approving review could never be given; the required checks are the gate.
